The coaching experience

Fierce compassion.
Divergent thinking.

Our work is collaborative and customized. Together, we explore recurring patterns, different perspectives, and practical approaches to change.

Dr. Mitran brings pattern recognition, a systems perspective, and an iterative mindset to understanding the connections between your experiences and behavior.

Topics we can explore

  • ND/NT communication and relationship dynamics
  • Sensory sensitivities and energy management
  • Masking, HSP traits, and cultivating autonomy
  • Relationship pacing and cultural values
  • Self-awareness and expressing needs

Practical details

Personalized support,
with room to think.

Online, in-person, and hybrid appointments are available through the practice, based in downtown San Francisco.

Begin with a paid consultation to discuss your situation, goals, and whether coaching is a good fit. Current fees and appointment details are provided through scheduling.

Before we begin

A few questions.

What happens in a consultation?

You can discuss your situation, goals, and needs, ask questions, and get a sense of Dr. Mitran’s approach. The consultation is paid and helps determine whether working together is a good fit.

Is coaching the same as therapy?

Coaching focuses on personal, professional, and relationship goals. Dr. Mitran’s clinical background informs her perspective; the services presented on this site are coaching.

Can we work together online?

The practice offers online, in-person, and hybrid appointments. Use the consultation to discuss the arrangements available for your needs.
